title: Fixed Front Hopper and Rear Screed Tracked Paver
description: One independently authored whole tracked paving-machine exterior: a low complete chassis on two thick polygonal hollow track loops and full rooted wheels/axles, a very broad front flared receiving hopper with real open empty mouth and full floor, a central sloped power-cover shape, and a complete rear open operator platform with one seat, blank side console and full U rails. Two long continuous draw arms link the chassis to a wide separate low screed-style exterior behind the machine. Every mesh is newly authored in this source; no old excavator, railway wagon, hopper, cabin or track mesh is imported or extracted. The full front receiving tub to rear spreading-block silhouette is the distinguishing whole structure, not a wheel/count/colour variant. One prop, zero scenes; four opaque solid PBR materials, metres, Z up, horizontally bounds-centred ground datum on both whole flat track soles. No conveyor, auger, engine or hydraulic internals, material flow, asphalt, paving/levelling ability, drive, turning, operator use, loads, guarding, manufacture, engineering, safety, rigging, animation or interaction. Static low-poly visual exterior only, not equipment design or operation guidance.
